title: tdh.util.audioOutSm~
description: `tdh.util.audioOutSm~` is a compact stereo output utility that sends its two signal inputs to the first two channels of the DAC selected in Pd’s Media → Audio Settings. It provides a volume fader with typed dBFS control (approximately −90 to +12 dB), mute and DSP on/off controls, and a faux VU meter.
